findings.title: Objectives renders and opens cached records after a current read is denied
reproduction: Load the client Objectives page with a successful list response.
Advance the cache clock by31 seconds, navigate to Capabilities, then back to Objectives.
Return403 for the second Objectives list GET.
The permission alert appears beside the cached Test outcome card. Clicking that cached card opens Edit objective with the old fields.
findings.expected: A denied current read must conceal old record content and prevent opening a current editor, while retaining a truthful retry state.
findings.observed: Two list reads are recorded; the second returns403, but the old outcome, problem, minimum win and edit drawer remain visible.
findings.deploymentImpact: Blocks current-access frontend acceptance of Objectives. This demonstrates stale denied-data presentation, not a server authorization bypass; no protected write or native access was attempted.
findings.certainty: Confirmed by an isolated browser reproduction against the real frozen components. The analogous ObjectiveSummary pattern is source-confirmed only.

findings.title: Work discards supplied owner identities in its document and node projections
reproduction: Supply a strategy node ownerUserId and Workspace draft ownerId through the existing fixtures.
Open Client work and inspect the node and document rows.
Compare the Workspace row to mobile Figma86349, where the product subtitle includes the owner name.
findings.expected: Show the supplied authorized owner through the existing member display contract, or a truthful unresolved-owner state.
findings.observed: The parsed ownerUserId/ownerId fields are never consumed anywhere in Work presentation. The screenshot shows product-only document subtitles and ownerless nodes; the upcoming projection also omits each individual node status.
findings.deploymentImpact: Blocks the remaining Work owner-display facet, not the previously accepted source isolation, destination, or legacy-name refusal behavior. Native member identity completeness still needs signed-in acceptance.
findings.certainty: Owner omission confirmed in source and rendered fixture. New Figma comparison is the mobile document owner subtitle; prior52106 capture is not repeated.
